title.en: An Act Declaring February 3 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Cabanatuan, Province of Nueva Ecija in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring February 3 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the City of Cabanatuan, Province of Nueva Ecija in Commemoration of its Founding Anniversary
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 3 tháng 2 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Cabanatuan, Tỉnh Nueva Ecija, nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 3 กุมภาพันธ์ของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในเมือง Cabanatuan จังหวัด Nueva Ecija เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 3 Februari setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Kota Cabanatuan, Provinsi Nueva Ecija, dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 3 Februari setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Bandar Cabanatuan, Wilayah Nueva Ecija, sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en: February 3 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the City of Cabanatuan, Province of Nueva Ecija, in commemoration of its founding anniversary. Upon proclamation of the President, February 3 of every year shall be a special non working holiday in the City of Cabanatuan, Province of Nueva Ecija.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
